title: Family visiting from India this summer? Eggless cakes near Merrylands
summary:
Grandparents landing from India for the summer holidays? The cake is the one thing on the table they will not need to ask about.

Every cake at our Harris Park shop is 100% eggless. Not the sponge, not the buttercream, not any of the 15 flavours. Vegetarian relatives, a cousin with an egg allergy, the uncle who reads every label: one cake, and nobody leaves the table to check an ingredient list.

For a welcome dinner in Merrylands, a 6-inch serves 6 to 8 from $39.99. When the whole extended family turns up, an 8-inch serves 12 to 14 from $49.99. Order with two days' notice and collect from Wigram Street, a short walk from Harris Park station.

Our team speaks Hindi and Gujarati, so Nani can choose the flavour herself.

Pickup only. Tap Learn more to order.
